verdict.rationale: The CLI's own `skills add <repo> --list` enumerates every skill in a source, with name and full trigger description, without installing anything; this was confirmed hands-on in a keyless runtime probe. `skills list` shows what is installed, and default project installs land in `./<agent>/skills/` (canonical copy plus symlinks) where they are committed with the project. However, the pre-install listing shows only names and descriptions, not the full SKILL.md instructions or bundled scripts. Reading files afterward relies on the plain filesystem rather than a documented inspect/show command. `skills use` printing a generated prompt to stdout is only an indirect preview. Missing for 10: a pre-install view of full file contents including bundled scripts, a dedicated per-skill file inspection command, and any diff or summary of what changes on update.
